name: SEGA semantic guidance (megapack)
plain: Adds or removes concepts, with a per-channel top-quantile mask, warm-up and momentum.
math:
ψ_i=sgn_i(d_ei−u); mask |ψ|≥quantile
γ_i=g_i s_e,i·mask·ψ_i in warm-up..cool-down
γ̄=γ+s_mν; ν←β_mν+(1−β_m)γ
x̂=u+wΔ+γ̄

props.params: g, thresholds, warmup, cooldown, s_m, beta_m

providers.author: AbstractEyes
providers.note: part of the megapack engine; docstring and return line read, full body not read
